an10.105:1.1: “Mendicants, ignorance precedes the attainment of unskillful qualities, with lack of conscience and prudence following along.
an10.105:1.2: An ignoramus, sunk in ignorance, produces wrong view. Wrong view produces wrong thought. Wrong thought produces wrong speech. Wrong speech produces wrong action. Wrong action produces wrong livelihood. Wrong livelihood produces wrong effort. Wrong effort produces wrong mindfulness. Wrong mindfulness produces wrong immersion. Wrong immersion produces wrong knowledge. Wrong knowledge produces wrong freedom.
an10.105:2.1: Knowledge precedes the attainment of skillful qualities, with conscience and prudence following along.
an10.105:2.2: A sage, firm in knowledge, gives rise to right view. Right view gives rise to right thought. Right thought gives rise to right speech. Right speech gives rise to right action. Right action gives rise to right livelihood. Right livelihood gives rise to right effort. Right effort gives rise to right mindfulness. Right mindfulness gives rise to right immersion. Right immersion gives rise to right knowledge. Right knowledge gives rise to right freedom.”
